task_reference_intro: Detailed walkthroughs and screenshots for all 33 Mysthaven tasks across 15 rooms. Screenshots show example gameplay states.

entries.title: Light the Chandeliers
entries.caption: Drag a fresh flame from the wall torch to each unlit wick until all six candles are burning.
entries.alt_text: Grand Hall chandelier puzzle with three of six candles lit
entries.markdown: ![Grand Hall chandelier puzzle with three of six candles lit](../media/tasks/01-light-the-chandeliers.jpeg)

entries.title: Restore the Crest
entries.caption: Use the restored crest as a reference and drag all four fragments into their matching gaps.
entries.alt_text: Restore the Crest puzzle window in Grand Hall
entries.markdown: ![Restore the Crest puzzle window in Grand Hall](../media/tasks/02-restore-the-crest.png)

entries.title: Return the Books
entries.caption: Match each book’s title and cover to the appropriate subject and drag it into the gap on that bookcase. Return all four books.
entries.alt_text: Return the Books puzzle window in Library
entries.markdown: ![Return the Books puzzle window in Library](../media/tasks/03-return-the-books.png)

entries.title: Decode the Cipher
entries.caption: Use the displayed symbol key to translate the runes, enter the letters in order, and press Confirm.
entries.alt_text: Decode the Cipher puzzle window in Library
entries.markdown: ![Decode the Cipher puzzle window in Library](../media/tasks/04-decode-the-cipher.png)

entries.title: Identify the Forged Record
entries.caption: Compare the four records with the authentic seal, signature, and date format. Select the forged record and mark it.
entries.alt_text: Identify the Forged Record puzzle window in Archives
entries.markdown: ![Identify the Forged Record puzzle window in Archives](../media/tasks/05-identify-the-forged-record.png)

entries.title: Restore Torn Record
entries.caption: Rotate and fit all eight fragments using the restored document as a guide, then press Complete Record.
entries.alt_text: Restore Torn Record puzzle window in Archives
entries.markdown: ![Restore Torn Record puzzle window in Archives](../media/tasks/06-restore-torn-record.png)

entries.title: Set the Table
entries.caption: Place one of each requested item at all six seats, then press Complete.
entries.alt_text: Set the Table puzzle window in Dining Hall
entries.markdown: ![Set the Table puzzle window in Dining Hall](../media/tasks/07-set-the-table.png)

entries.title: Inspect Serving Ledger
entries.caption: Multiply tables by servings for each course. Adjust the wrong total with −/+ and press Balance.
entries.alt_text: Inspect Serving Ledger puzzle window in Dining Hall
entries.markdown: ![Inspect Serving Ledger puzzle window in Dining Hall](../media/tasks/08-inspect-serving-ledger.png)

entries.title: Prepare the Order
entries.caption: Read the order card, add each ingredient in the requested order and quantity, then press Mix Solution.
entries.alt_text: Prepare the Order puzzle window in Kitchen
entries.markdown: ![Prepare the Order puzzle window in Kitchen](../media/tasks/09-prepare-the-order.png)

entries.title: Check Pantry List
entries.caption: Select the three jars on the pantry list and press Check.
entries.alt_text: Check Pantry List puzzle window in Kitchen
entries.markdown: ![Check Pantry List puzzle window in Kitchen](../media/tasks/10-check-pantry-list.png)

entries.title: Stop the Stove Flare
entries.caption: Press Stop Heat when the marker enters the striped zone. Repeat as the zone shifts and narrows.
entries.alt_text: Stop the Stove Flare puzzle window in Kitchen
entries.markdown: ![Stop the Stove Flare puzzle window in Kitchen](../media/tasks/11-stop-the-stove-flare.png)

entries.title: Restore the Garden Lanterns
entries.caption: Start the puzzle, watch the lantern sequence, and tap the lanterns in the same order. Complete all rounds.
entries.alt_text: Restore the Garden Lanterns puzzle window in Courtyard Garden
entries.markdown: ![Restore the Garden Lanterns puzzle window in Courtyard Garden](../media/tasks/12-restore-the-garden-lanterns.png)

entries.title: Collect Moon Herbs
entries.caption: Match the names and pictures on the request cards to four plants and tap each match.
entries.alt_text: Collect Moon Herbs puzzle window in Courtyard Garden
entries.markdown: ![Collect Moon Herbs puzzle window in Courtyard Garden](../media/tasks/13-collect-moon-herbs.png)

entries.title: Examine Fountain
entries.caption: Rotate the pipes to create one continuous water route with no open joints.
entries.alt_text: Examine Fountain puzzle window in Courtyard Garden
entries.markdown: ![Examine Fountain puzzle window in Courtyard Garden](../media/tasks/14-examine-fountain.png)

entries.title: Check Stair Lock
entries.caption: Tap stones to toggle them and their neighbors until the whole grid is lit.
entries.alt_text: Check Stair Lock puzzle window in Courtyard Garden
entries.markdown: ![Check Stair Lock puzzle window in Courtyard Garden](../media/tasks/15-check-stair-lock.png)

entries.title: Synchronize the Clock
entries.caption: Drag the hands or use −/+ to match the target time, then press Lock.
entries.alt_text: Synchronize the Clock puzzle window in Clock Tower
entries.markdown: ![Synchronize the Clock puzzle window in Clock Tower](../media/tasks/16-synchronize-the-clock.png)

entries.title: Replace the Gear
entries.caption: Match a gear to the slot’s shape and dimensions. Drag it into place and press Test Rotation.
entries.alt_text: Replace the Gear puzzle window in Clock Tower
entries.markdown: ![Replace the Gear puzzle window in Clock Tower](../media/tasks/17-replace-the-gear.png)

entries.title: Reconnect CCTV
entries.caption: Drag each camera plug to the socket with the matching symbol and color.
entries.alt_text: Reconnect CCTV puzzle window in Security
entries.markdown: ![Reconnect CCTV puzzle window in Security](../media/tasks/18-reconnect-cctv.png)

entries.title: Review Camera Footage
entries.caption: Scrub through the feeds, choose the anomaly type and press Flag Feed while the evidence is visible.
entries.alt_text: Review Camera Footage puzzle window in Security
entries.markdown: ![Review Camera Footage puzzle window in Security](../media/tasks/19-review-camera-footage.png)

entries.title: Analyze the Sample
entries.caption: Insert the capsule and hold the frequency within 64 ± 8 for two seconds. At 100%, press Confirm Signature.
entries.alt_text: Analyze the Sample puzzle window in Research Lab
entries.markdown: ![Analyze the Sample puzzle window in Research Lab](../media/tasks/20-analyze-the-sample.png)

entries.title: Mix the Formula
entries.caption: Add each ingredient in the order and quantity on the formula card, then press Mix Solution.
entries.alt_text: Mix the Formula puzzle window in Research Lab
entries.markdown: ![Mix the Formula puzzle window in Research Lab](../media/tasks/21-mix-the-formula.png)

entries.title: Scan Vitals
entries.caption: Hold the scan button and steer the indicator into the center band until progress reaches 100%.
entries.alt_text: Scan Vitals puzzle window in Infirmary
entries.markdown: ![Scan Vitals puzzle window in Infirmary](../media/tasks/22-scan-vitals.png)

entries.title: Collect Supplies
entries.caption: Add up what both beds need, dispense those quantities and press Pack Tray. Tap a tray compartment to return extras.
entries.alt_text: Collect Supplies puzzle window in Infirmary
entries.markdown: ![Collect Supplies puzzle window in Infirmary](../media/tasks/23-collect-supplies.png)

entries.title: Reaction Drill
entries.caption: Press Start Drill and click each raised target’s bullseye before it drops.
entries.alt_text: Reaction Drill puzzle window in Training Hall
entries.markdown: ![Reaction Drill puzzle window in Training Hall](../media/tasks/24-reaction-drill.png)

entries.title: Inspect Rack
entries.caption: Match all three items to their chalk outlines by dragging or by selecting an item and tapping its destination.
entries.alt_text: Inspect Rack puzzle window in Training Hall
entries.markdown: ![Inspect Rack puzzle window in Training Hall](../media/tasks/25-inspect-rack.png)

entries.title: Repair Wiring
entries.caption: Drag each of the four plugs to the terminal of the same color.
entries.alt_text: Repair Wiring puzzle window in Maintenance
entries.markdown: ![Repair Wiring puzzle window in Maintenance](../media/tasks/26-repair-wiring.png)

entries.title: Restart the Generator
entries.caption: Insert the spare fuse, hold to prime the generator, keep the voltage in the safe zone, then pull the start lever.
entries.alt_text: Restart the Generator puzzle window in Maintenance
entries.markdown: ![Restart the Generator puzzle window in Maintenance](../media/tasks/27-restart-the-generator.png)

entries.title: Balance the Supply Lift
entries.caption: Place the 25 kg and 15 kg crates on one side and both 20 kg crates on the other. Press Test Lift.
entries.alt_text: Balance the Supply Lift puzzle window in Storage
entries.markdown: ![Balance the Supply Lift puzzle window in Storage](../media/tasks/28-balance-the-supply-lift.png)

entries.title: Find Inventory
entries.caption: Open two crates at a time and match their stamps until all four pairs are found.
entries.alt_text: Find Inventory puzzle window in Storage
entries.markdown: ![Find Inventory puzzle window in Storage](../media/tasks/29-find-inventory.png)

entries.title: Restore Passage Lights
entries.caption: Rotate the tiles to route power from the generator to the lamps. Use Test Circuit to check for unpowered lamps and open ends.
entries.alt_text: Restore Passage Lights puzzle window in Underground Passage
entries.markdown: ![Restore Passage Lights puzzle window in Underground Passage](../media/tasks/30-restore-passage-lights.png)

entries.title: Check Valve
entries.caption: Press Start, then use Pump and Bleed to keep the gauge in the stable range until the interval ends.
entries.alt_text: Check Valve puzzle window in Underground Passage
entries.markdown: ![Check Valve puzzle window in Underground Passage](../media/tasks/31-check-valve.png)

entries.title: Stabilize the Veil
entries.caption: Flip the rune marked Reversed, adjust all three channels into their target bands, then hold Hold to Seal while keeping the stability marker in the safe zone.
entries.alt_text: Stabilize the Veil puzzle window in Veil Chamber
entries.markdown: ![Stabilize the Veil puzzle window in Veil Chamber](../media/tasks/32-stabilize-the-veil.png)

entries.title: Inspect Boundary Seal
entries.caption: Start at the glowing gem, follow all five links in either direction and return to the starting gem.
entries.alt_text: Inspect Boundary Seal puzzle window in Veil Chamber
entries.markdown: ![Inspect Boundary Seal puzzle window in Veil Chamber](../media/tasks/33-inspect-boundary-seal.png)

entries.title: Crew role reveal
entries.caption: Complete tasks, report bodies, and use meetings to help identify the Impostor.
entries.alt_text: Mysthaven Crew role reveal screen showing the role objective and controls
entries.markdown: ![Mysthaven Crew role reveal screen showing the role objective and controls](../media/role-reveal/crew-reveal.png)

entries.title: Engineer role reveal
entries.caption: Complete tasks and help find the Impostor. Vent access unlocks after two tasks.
entries.alt_text: Mysthaven Engineer role reveal screen showing the role objective and controls
entries.markdown: ![Mysthaven Engineer role reveal screen showing the role objective and controls](../media/role-reveal/engineer-reveal.png)

entries.title: Impostor role reveal
entries.caption: Use fake tasks to blend in. The reveal shows the Kill, Summon, and Vent controls.
entries.alt_text: Mysthaven Impostor role reveal screen showing the role objective and controls
entries.markdown: ![Mysthaven Impostor role reveal screen showing the role objective and controls](../media/role-reveal/impostor-reveal.png)
